contexts.text: Modest speech of the Church Enos.
The Gentiles behave themselves modestly... AC 2602.
(The Spirits of the pia mater) were modest and pacific. SE 1727. SE 1728.
Some of the (Spirits of the chyle) are modest; some petulant.
(The Spirits of the peritoneum) answered them modestly. SE 991.
There shone forth from (the faces of the inhabitants of Jupiter) what was sincere and modest.
In other respects they have appeared modest...
(The Spirits of Saturn) are modest.
In other respects (the Spirits of the First Earth) were modest...
Modesty (one of the virtues which pertain to the moral wisdom of the men).
The intelligence of women is modest...
I added, From her connate modesty.
They are very modest.
Their dress modest...
These infernals had appeared modest... SE 3007.
Otherwise he is modest...
In the sight of men he had appeared modest...
Their modest rejections of the evil endeavours... were instantaneous, with such modesty that they never hurt those who were making them.
Charles XII. an example of those who are exteriorly civil and modest.
Those who are modest, but study themselves only.
